name: @dafuga01/harness
description: An opinionated CLI that helps humans and agents code in small, Rails-inspired harnesses.

scripts.build: bun run build:cli && bun run --cwd packages/reports build && bun scripts/package-reports.ts
scripts.check: bun run format:check && bun run typecheck && bun run lint && bun run test:unit && bun run test:e2e && bun run build && bun run test:package && bun run dev -- audit . && bun run --cwd packages/reports check
scripts.test:e2e: vitest run test/cli.e2e.test.ts test/rules.e2e.test.ts test/ecosystem-adapters.e2e.test.ts test/structure.e2e.test.ts test/dapp-audit.e2e.test.ts test/complex-feature.e2e.test.ts test/loop.e2e.test.ts test/audit-config.e2e.test.ts test/clean-code.e2e.test.ts test/response-check.e2e.test.ts test/analytics.e2e.test.ts test/analytics-attribution.e2e.test.ts test/analytics-worktrees.e2e.test.ts test/codex-gateway.e2e.test.ts test/session-hooks.e2e.test.ts
